# Mod API: Model, Audio, and MCP

`$.model` asks a model with the credentials of the session.
`$.audio` plays a sound or speaks text.
`$.mcp` calls a tool of a connected MCP server.
The model call bills to the plan or key of the person, so keep requests small.
This hook answers `/triage` by asking a small model for a label:

```javascript
on('command.run', { command: 'triage' }, async ($, e) => {
  const r = await $.model.complete({
    model: 'haiku',
    system: 'Reply with one word: bug, feature, or question.',
    prompt: e.args,
    maxTokens: 20,
  })
  return { text: 'Label: ' + (r.isAnswered ? r.text.trim() : 'unknown') }
})
```

`maxTokens` is 1024 by default and goes up to 64000 or the output limit of the model.

In the "Where" column, **Run time** means in a hook, in a closure that a hook drew, or in a timer callback.
It does not mean inside `register`.

## Members

| Mark | Item | What it does | How it works | Where it can be used | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ✅ | `$.model.complete` | Runs one text completion through the session's own API client and resolves a result: the reply's text and cost, or why there is no text. | Type: `(request, options?) => Promise<ModelCompleteResult>`. Asks the model once, with no tools and no history. Only a request that the engine refuses to send rejects. | Run time. | `CoreEngineInterface` line 2667, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `$.model.fork` | Runs one tool-less completion over the session's OWN transcript as the main thread last sent it, so the API serves that prefix from its cache. | Type: `(request: ModelForkRequest) => Promise<ModelForkResult>`. Repeats the main thread's last request with your `prompt` added. Every tool is denied. Always resolves a result. | Run time. | `CoreEngineInterface` line 2686, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `$.model.classify` | Picks one of `labels` for `text` with one completion over `$.model.complete` and a fixed classifier prompt. | Type: `(text, labels, options?) => Promise<string \| undefined>`. Picks one of 2 or more `labels` for `text`. Resolves `undefined` if the model names none. | Run time. | `CoreEngineInterface` line 2705, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `$.audio.play` | Plays one audio clip, starting now, clips are not queued, so two calls play together (a bed under speech). | Type: `(clip: AudioClip, options?: PlayOptions) => Promise<void>`. Plays a sound file. `afplay` plays it on macOS. Linux and Windows terminals play nothing. | Run time. | `CoreEngineInterface` line 2726, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `$.audio.speak` | Speaks `text` with the platform's own synthesizer (`say` on macOS). Plain text. | Type: `(text: string, options?: SpeakOptions) => Promise<SpeakResult>`. Speaks `text` with the system voice. Utterances queue. Rejects if there is no synthesizer. | Run time. | `CoreEngineInterface` line 2740, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `$.mcp.call` | Calls `tool` on one of the engine's connected MCP servers with the engine's own connection and credentials. | Type: `(server: string, tool: string, args?) => Promise<McpToolResult>`. Calls a tool on a connected MCP server. No permission prompt appears, because the plugin's call is the grant. | Run time. | `CoreEngineInterface` line 2767, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |
| ✅ | `$.mcp.connect` | Connects one of the MCP servers this plugin's own manifest lists, if the session has not already: a listed server joins it at its start. | Type: `(server: string) => Promise<McpConnectResult>`. Connects a server that this plugin lists in its manifest. Listing it defers nothing, so refuse its calls at `tool.check` to hold them back. | Server key must be listed in this plugin's manifest. | `CoreEngineInterface` line 2784, [Mods Reference](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/reference) |

Value: `ModelCompleteResult`. A hook above the caller returns `next(e)`, `{ deny: reason }` or `{ value }`. The signal does not cross, it aborts the call. | Hook via `on('model.complete', ...)`.
